name: manos-mcp

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List all available local devices (Android emulators/devices via adb, iOS simulators via simctl). Returns id, platform, name, OS version, and state.

tools.name: inspect_screen
tools.description: Get the current screen's view hierarchy as compact JSON with stable element ids. Use the 'id' field with act tools (tap/input_text/...), or target by text/resource-id. Copy text verbatim — never retype from a screenshot.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot of the current device screen.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: run_flow
tools.description: Run a Maestro flow (delegates to the maestro CLI). Provide exactly one of: yaml (inline), files (paths), or dir. Optional include_tags/exclude_tags (for dir) and env vars.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: cheat_sheet
tools.description: Return Maestro flow syntax guidance and best practices for writing/exporting flows.

tools.name: device_capabilities
tools.description: Report which actions are supported on a device (full/partial/unavailable) with the backend and any caveats. Check this before relying on a platform-specific action.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap an element (by id/text/resource_id/accessibility) or absolute coordinates. Returns the resulting screen state (act+observe) so you don't need a separate inspect call.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

x.description: Absolute x coordinate (alternative to a selector)

y.description: Absolute y coordinate (alternative to a selector)

index.description: Pick the Nth match (0-based) when several match

ocr.description: Force OCR: locate `text` visually in the screenshot instead of the a11y tree (for off-tree / canvas / WebView elements). OCR is also used automatically when a text selector finds nothing in the tree.

observe.description: What to return after the action: 'screen' = fresh compact hierarchy, 'diff' = only what changed since last inspect, 'screenshot' = PNG, 'none' = just confirm.

tools.name: long_press
tools.description: Long-press an element or coordinates for a duration (ms).

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

x.description: Absolute x coordinate (alternative to a selector)

y.description: Absolute y coordinate (alternative to a selector)

index.description: Pick the Nth match (0-based) when several match

ocr.description: Force OCR: locate `text` visually in the screenshot instead of the a11y tree (for off-tree / canvas / WebView elements). OCR is also used automatically when a text selector finds nothing in the tree.

observe.description: What to return after the action: 'screen' = fresh compact hierarchy, 'diff' = only what changed since last inspect, 'screenshot' = PNG, 'none' = just confirm.

tools.name: input_text
tools.description: Type text into the focused field. Optionally target a field first (id/text/resource_id) to tap it before typing.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

per_char_delay_ms.description: Per-character typing delay in ms (default 60). Raise it if a field with live formatting (e.g. a credit-card input) drops or reorders characters; set 0 to commit the whole string at once.

observe.description: What to return after the action: 'screen' = fresh compact hierarchy, 'diff' = only what changed since last inspect, 'screenshot' = PNG, 'none' = just confirm.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a hardware/system key. Android: back, home, enter, tab, delete, search, menu, volume_up, volume_down, app_switch, power. iOS: enter, delete, tab, space, escape, home, lock, siri.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

observe.description: What to return after the action: 'screen' = fresh compact hierarchy, 'diff' = only what changed since last inspect, 'screenshot' = PNG, 'none' = just confirm.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe by direction (up/down/left/right) or between two coordinate points. Direction swipes are centered on the screen.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

observe.description: What to return after the action: 'screen' = fresh compact hierarchy, 'diff' = only what changed since last inspect, 'screenshot' = PNG, 'none' = just confirm.

tools.name: assert
tools.description: Assert an element is visible or not visible on the current screen. Returns pass/fail without polling (use wait_for to wait).

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Poll the screen until an element becomes visible or not_visible, or timeout. Replaces fixed sleeps — fast when ready, patient when not.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: find_elements
tools.description: Search the current screen for elements matching a query. Returns matching elements (id, bounds, text, etc.) — handy to disambiguate before acting.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: find_text
tools.description: OCR the current screenshot and return on-screen text with pixel bounding boxes — finds elements the accessibility tree misses (styled buttons, canvas/Flutter/game UIs, WebViews). Optionally filter by a query. Tap a result with tap{text, ocr:true}.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Launch an app by bundle id (iOS) / package name (Android). Optionally clear state first.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

observe.description: What to return after the action: 'screen' = fresh compact hierarchy, 'diff' = only what changed since last inspect, 'screenshot' = PNG, 'none' = just confirm.

tools.name: stop_app
tools.description: Force-stop / terminate an app.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: clear_app_state
tools.description: Reset app state. Android: full data wipe (pm clear). iOS: resets permissions (full data wipe needs reinstall).

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: open_deeplink
tools.description: Open a deep link / universal link URL on the device.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

observe.description: What to return after the action: 'screen' = fresh compact hierarchy, 'diff' = only what changed since last inspect, 'screenshot' = PNG, 'none' = just confirm.

tools.name: set_permission
tools.description: Grant or revoke a runtime permission for an app. Aliases: camera, microphone, location, contacts, photos, notifications, calendar, etc.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: set_appearance
tools.description: Switch the system appearance between light and dark mode.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: set_orientation
tools.description: Set device orientation (portrait, landscape-left, landscape-right, upside-down). Android only; iOS simulators must be rotated via the Simulator menu.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: set_locale
tools.description: Set app locale (BCP-47, e.g. 'fr-FR'). Android: per-app, requires API 33+. iOS: applied by relaunching the app. Provide app_id.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: set_network
tools.description: Toggle wifi/cellular/airplane mode. Android only (emulator/device); iOS simulators share the host network (use Network Link Conditioner).

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: set_location
tools.description: Set the simulated GPS location. Android: emulator only. iOS: any simulator.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: set_font_scale
tools.description: Set text size for accessibility testing. scale 1.0 = default. Android sets font_scale directly; iOS maps to the nearest Dynamic Type size.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: set_status_bar
tools.description: Override the status bar (time, battery, signal) for clean screenshots. iOS: rich (simctl). Android: clock/battery/signal via SystemUI demo mode.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: push_notification
tools.description: Deliver a push notification. iOS: injects an APNs payload via simctl push. Android: unavailable (needs FCM server key + token).

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: set_conditions
tools.description: Apply multiple device conditions in one call — the edge-case states where bugs hide. Use a named preset and/or explicit fields (explicit overrides the preset). Each condition reports applied/skipped/failed (unsupported ones are skipped with a reason, not a failure). Presets: reset (Restore defaults: light mode, 1.0 text, online.); screenshot (Clean marketing state: light mode + a pristine 9:41 status bar.); accessibility (Accessibility stress: largest text + dark mode.); offline (No connectivity (airplane mode / radios off).); dark (Dark appearance.); international (Foreign locale (defaults to fr-FR; override with `locale`). Needs app_id.).

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Fetch recent device logs (Android logcat / iOS unified log) with automatic crash & ANR detection. Filter by app_id, substring, time window, and line cap.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: a11y_audit
tools.description: Audit the current screen for accessibility issues: undersized touch targets, unlabeled interactive controls, and duplicate labels. (Color-contrast needs pixels and is not evaluated.)

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: network_start
tools.description: Capture decrypted HTTP, filtered to specific endpoints. Android: hooks OkHttp via Frida in a debuggable app (app_id required; needs frida-server). iOS simulator: routes the sim through mitmproxy with a simctl-trusted CA (app_id optional; temporarily sets the macOS proxy, restored on stop). `filter` is a URL regex (e.g. 'v2/search').

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

app_id.description: Package/bundle id. Required on Android; optional on iOS (proxy is device-wide).

filter.description: URL regex; only matching requests are recorded

spawn.description: Android only: spawn the app fresh to capture startup traffic

tools.name: network_requests
tools.description: Return captured HTTP exchanges (method, url, status). Compact by default; set include_headers/include_body for detail. Filter by URL regex and limit count to avoid flooding.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

filter.description: Further filter captured URLs by regex

since_ts.description: Only return exchanges after this epoch-seconds timestamp

tools.name: network_clear
tools.description: Clear the captured-request buffer without stopping the capture.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: network_stop
tools.description: Stop capturing (detach Frida / stop mitmproxy and restore the macOS proxy).

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

tools.name: network_mock
tools.description: Override API responses to test hard-to-reproduce states (Android). Each rule matches requests by URL regex (+ optional method) and can override the status/headers, replace the body, regex-rewrite the live body (change one field, keep the rest), or inject latency. First match wins; rules hot-reload; capture keeps logging (mocked exchanges flagged). Android (Frida/OkHttp): call network_start with app_id first — mocking rides the capture hook (abort not yet supported). iOS response mocking is in development (network_start still captures). `replace:true` (default) replaces all rules; an empty list clears mocking.

device_id.description: Device id from list_devices (adb serial like 'emulator-5554', or an iOS simulator UDID)

method.description: HTTP method filter (GET/POST/...); any if omitted

body.description: Replace the whole response body (JSON as a string)

rewrite.description: Regex find/replace on the live response body — change specific fields, keep the rest

abort.description: Fail the request (connection error). iOS only.

rules.description: Mock rules; first match wins. Empty list with replace=true clears all mocks.

replace.description: Replace all rules (true) or append to existing (false)

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Begin recording subsequent act tools as a session that can be exported to a replayable Maestro flow (export_flow) or an annotated HTML report (export_report). Set report=true to also screenshot after each action for the report.

report.description: Capture a screenshot after each action, for export_report

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Stop recording the current session (keeps recorded steps for export_flow).

tools.name: export_flow
tools.description: Export the recorded session as a replayable Maestro flow (YAML) plus a human-readable report. Run it later with run_flow.

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Write a self-contained HTML report of the recorded session — a step timeline with screenshots (if report capture was on) plus an appendix with the replayable flow, captured network requests, and recent logs/crashes. Returns the file path. Best with start_recording(report=true).

output_path.description: Where to write the .html (default: temp dir)

instructions: Control Android emulators/devices and iOS simulators for ad-hoc UI testing. Workflow: list_devices -> inspect_screen -> act (tap/input_text/swipe) which return the new screen state. Use device_capabilities to check platform support, get_logs for crashes, a11y_audit for accessibility, and start_recording/export_flow to turn a session into a replayable Maestro flow.
